(b) that all deliverables and work products in the form of works of authorship developed by CRO in the performance of Services under this Agreement shall be deemed works made for hire, and shall belong fully and exclusively to Client; and that if by operation of law such deliverables or work products are not works made for hire, CRO agrees to, and does hereby, assign to Client all right, title, and interest in such deliverables or work product, including all copyrights therein;

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed the document and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before we proceed with signing.- Regarding the liability cap in the relevant clause, your indemnification obligations and intellectual property claims are carved out from the liability cap, exposing you to unlimited financial risk for those claims. I propose modifying this so that notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, each party's total liability in respect of damages under this Agreement shall be limited to the sum of all amounts received from Client in terms of this Agreement.- Regarding the intellectual property assignment, intellectual property ownership of your work product transfers immediately upon creation or development without a condition that you have been paid in full. I propose modifying this so that upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services, [PARTY_A] agrees to assign to Client all inventions specifically derived from the work assigned by Client.- Regarding the works made for hire provision, intellectual property ownership transfers to the client immediately upon creation or delivery, before you are guaranteed payment. I propose modifying this so that all intellectual property rights in the deliverables shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has paid all undisputed invoices in full, upon which such rights shall transfer to the Client.Please let me know if these adjustments work for you so we can finalize the agreement. Best regards,
